name: Motor-Driven Cycle, up to 5 hp
description: The motor-driven cycle the classifications naming this group share: a motorcycle whose motor produces no more than 5 brake horsepower (3,750 W). A vehicle carries this group's id in place of each classification in it, and each of those holds its own jurisdiction's license, registration, insurance, helmet and riding rules.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and no more than three wheels
Its motor produces no more than 5 brake horsepower (3,750 W)
Past its jurisdiction's e-bike limits, and its moped's where the jurisdiction has one
restrictions.citation: Revised Code of Washington §46.04.332; Wyoming Statutes §31-5-102(a)(xxiii)
